sg: Sg means the same as seaborgium or element 106 or atomic number 106.
sga infant: SGA infant is an infant whose size and weight are considerably less than the average for babies of the same age.
SGA infant means the same as small-for-gestational-age infant.
sgml: SGML is a standardized language for the descriptive markup of documents.
SGML means the same as standard generalized markup language.
sgraffito: A sgraffito is a ceramic or mural decoration made by scratching off a surface layer to reveal the ground.
